name: Lysine
summary: Lysine has modest RCT support for cold-sore prevention at 1-3 g/d, paired with a massive user base. A case study in popular use outrunning the evidence.
description: Canonical Lysine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.

research_metadata.evidence_notes: Modest cold-sore prevention RCTs at 1-3 g/d (PMIDs flagged verify-before-publishing).
